**How to keep up with AI-found bugs: good, better, best.**

Postgres 19 is running late because LLMs find bugs faster than humans can fix them.

Robert Haas counts **back-patched commits up more than 60%** in one year.

Each level builds on the last.

**Which level is your team at? Save this.**
bullets: Good: triage reports by severity with a cut-off. Niche bugs stay open forever.
Better: pause feature work until the backlog shrinks. The roadmap stalls.
Best: run the bug hunt on every PR before merge. Fixes still need a human reviewer.
